title: RAYE feat. Hans Zimmer · Click Clack Symphony.
description: The complete official music video: B&W globe wrapped in musical staves, moody London manor parlor and tufted teal pillow sofa, crimson Friday-night neon room, gravity-tilted hall, South London terraced street with piano-key zebra crossing and drifting eighth-notes, giant flying eighth-note over London and a medieval castle, and golden-hour English downs in a scarlet feather coat. Original Hans Zimmer orchestration with two physical mouth-engine voices.
